review_candidates.title: Systeem Engineer
review_candidates.description: Als Systeembeheerder... ... draag jij dagelijks bij aan een veilige, betrouwbare en innovatieve IT-omgeving. Bij DSW beheren én bouwen we onze complexe IT-infrastructuur grotendeels zelf. Geen simpele systemen, maar uitdagend maatwerk op hoog niveau. Je installeert en configureert zowel hardware als software, en gebruikt automatiseringstools en scripting om processen voorspelbaar en schaalbaar te maken. Met jouw analytische blik adviseer je over complexe technische vraagstukken en ontwerp je mee aan de toekomst van onze infrastructuur. Bij complexe incidenten onderzoek je het vraagstuk grondig en daarnaast signaleer je proactief structurele verbeteringen. Ook borg je onze hoge standaarden voor informatiebeveiliging door processen helder te documenteren. Omdat de applicaties altijd beschikbaar zijn, draai je periodiek mee in waakdiensten om de continuïteit van onze belangrijkste bedrijfsprocessen buiten kantoortijden te garanderen. Hierom wil je het doen Op onze ICT-afdeling van ruim 300 professionals zit niemand stil. Je landt op de afdeling Service & Beheer: een hecht, hardwerkend team van zo’n 16 ervaren IT-collega’s. Samen dragen jullie de zorg voor onze complete infrastructuur van netwerken, (gevirtualiseerde) servers en cloud-omgevingen tot interfaces, storage, back-ups en telefonie. Nieuwe technologieën zoals AI en Kubernetes? We analyseren en verwelkomen ze samen om te ontdekken hoe we ze slim en effectief kunnen inzetten. De sfeer binnen het team is professioneel en informeel: de lijnen zijn kort, eigen initiatief wordt gewaardeerd en we boeken de beste resultaten écht als team. Wat breng jij mee? Een afgeronde HBO- of WO-opleiding in een relevante richting. Een duidelijke passie voor en affiniteit met IT-infrastructuur en de nieuwste technologieën. Sterke communicatieve vaardigheden: je zoekt makkelijk de verbinding met collega’s, ontwikkelaars en management. Een groot verantwoordelijkheidsgevoel, een gezonde dosis flexibiliteit en een analytische, gestructureerde manier van probleemoplossing. Dit bieden wij jou Een professionele werkomgeving in een informele sfeer, leuke collega’s, ruimte voor jouw persoonlijke ontwikkeling. Salaris conform CAO Zorgverzekeraars; de functie is ingedeeld in schaal 9 en schaal 10. Het salaris bedraagt minimaal € 3.387,- en maximaal € 5.833,- op basis van 34 uur. Uitstekende arbeidsvoorwaarden (dertiende maand, mogelijkheid tot bijkopen vakantiedagen en een aantrekkelijke sabbatical regeling met gedeeltelijke loondoorbetaling). Een flexibel mobiliteitsbeleid met aandacht voor vitaliteit en duurzaamheid. Denk hierbij aan een fietsvergoeding van € 0,23 per kilometer, aanschaf vergoeding van € 1.000,- voor een fiets en een volledige OV-vergoeding voor het woon-werk traject. Op loopafstand van station Schiedam Centrum. Gratis fruit op het werk, een inpandige fitnessruimte met moderne apparatuur, groepslessen en personal trainers. Aandacht voor een gezonde balans tussen werk en privé door flexibele werktijden. Faciliteiten om thuis te werken. Een actieve personeelsvereniging. Sollicitatieprocedure Zodra jouw sollicitatie bij ons binnen is, bekijken we je CV en motivatie. Zien we een match? Dan ontvang je van ons een uitnodiging voor een online assessment (intelligentietest en persoonlijke competenties). De resultaten van dit assessment zijn voor ons doorslaggevend voor het vervolg: bij een goed resultaat maken we graag persoonlijk kennis tijdens een sollicitatiegesprek. Als we daarna allebei enthousiast zijn, doen we je een passend contractvoorstel. Disclaimer Wij vinden het belangrijk om de selectieprocedure zo goed en zorgvuldig mogelijk te kunnen uitvoeren. Het screenen van openbare social media pagina's zoals LinkedIn of Instagram behoort hierbij tot de mogelijkheden. Mocht deze screening vragen oproepen, dan zal dit tijdens een eventueel selectiegesprek bespreekbaar worden gemaakt. Acquisitie en andere aanbiedingen van vergelijkbare diensten naar aanleiding van deze vacature stellen wij niet op prijs. Vragen? Neem dan contact op met Rob Graveland via robgraveland@dsw.nl of 010 - 2466270.

review_candidates.title: Recovery Driver - Newcastle
review_candidates.description: Job Description Feel like your current job’s going nowhere fast? Shift gears with The AA. Salary: Guaranteed minimum c. £34,885 for CE (HGV 1) license, £31,405 for C (HGV 2) license On Target Earnings: £41,000 for a CE licence, and £35,000 for a C licence Shifts: Rolling roster, work 18 days out of every 28, with two full weekends off. Standard Shift Duration: 9 hours and 45 minutes, including a 45-minute break. Flexibility Required: While standard shifts are under 10 hours, end-of-shift flexibility is essential. You may be required to work up to 12 hours (including breaks) depending on operational needs. Depot Postcode: NE11 9JL To be eligible for this role you must live within 25 miles or 1 hours travel from the depot. As an HGV Recovery Driver, you’ll often work independently, but the moment you step out of your truck, you become a source of calm and confidence. With empathy and resilience, you’ll support members through stressful moments, using your technical expertise to recover vehicles safely and efficiently. Whether it’s transporting a vehicle to a garage or helping someone reach their destination, you’ll make a real difference in their day and their journey. What will I be doing? Delivering exceptional service by safely recovering vehicles and reassuring customers during breakdowns, helping them get back on the road quickly. Working independently across varied locations and conditions, while remaining a valued part of a supportive team. Solving problems on the spot, using your technical skills and calm approach to handle a wide range of roadside situations. Staying solution-focused and compliant with EU Regulations & WTD, representing The AA with professionalism and a drive to always “Push for Better.” Qualifications What do I need? A full Category C (HGV Class 2) driving licence is essential. If you already hold a Category CE (HGV Class 1) licence — great! If not, don’t worry — we’ll support you in gaining it. A valid Driver CPC (Certificate of Professional Competence) and a digital tachograph card. Confidence using and adapting to new technology — we’ll provide the tools; you bring the curiosity. Flexibility to work shift patterns, including evenings, weekends, and Bank Holidays because breakdowns don’t stick to a schedule. Additional Information We’re always looking to recognise and reward our employees for the work they do. As a valued member of The AA team, you’ll have access to a range of benefits including: 23 days annual leave (increases with service) + holiday buying scheme Worksave pension scheme with up to 7% employer contribution Free AA breakdown membership from Day 1 plus 50% discount for family and friends Discounts on AA products including car and home insurance Employee discount scheme that gives you access to a car salary sacrifice scheme plus great discounts on healthcare, shopping, holidays and more Company funded life assurance Diverse learning and development opportunities to support you to progress in your career Dedicated Employee Assistance Programme and a 24/7 remote GP service for you and your family Plus, so much more! We’re proud to be an inclusive employer and welcome people from all backgrounds. At The AA, you’re encouraged to be yourself, thrive in your role, and feel like you truly belong. To apply, simply complete our short online application. If successful, we’ll invite you to an online interview and carry out standard pre-employment checks, including references, credit, and criminal record screening. Ready for anything? Apply Today

Develop structured test case scenarios (positive, negative, boundary, exception) using appropriate techniques (e.g., decision tables, state transition, equivalence partitioning). Ensure that all test plans align with both Agile and Waterfall methodologies, depending on project requirements. Identify gaps in product requirements during grooming sessions and proactively suggest improvements. 2. Work closely with developers and product managers to ensure timely bug fixes and incident handling. Test role-based access control based on user profiles, roles, permissions, and assigned locations. Assess whether Japanese translations and expressions are natural, clear, and easy for Japanese users to understand, rather than being literal translations. Health Insurance package from Bao Viet. 13-months and Performance Bonus. 14 days of Paid Leave Annually.

review_candidates.description: Your Job DEPCOM Power, a leading renewable energy EPC firm, is seeking a Project Manager for the Southwest portfolio to lead the execution of utility-scale Solar PV, Battery Energy Storage, and Repowering projects from pre-construction through commissioning and closeout. As a Project Manager, you will create long-term value by leading project teams that deliver safe, reliable, and profitable results. You will apply Principle Based Management to strengthen ownership, improve execution discipline, make sound economic decisions, and build trusted customer and stakeholder relationships from pre-construction through closeout. This is a remote role that requires travel to field construction project sites at a frequency between 25% - 50% dependent on project need. Our Team DEPCOM's Project Delivery Organization executes turnkey PV, Battery Energy Storage, and Repower projects, including collection substations and generation transmission lines. The team partners with vendors, subcontractors, utilities, and internal capabilities to deliver disciplined project execution and strong customer outcomes nationwide. What You Will Do Lead project teams to deliver safe, reliable, and profitable outcomes across scope, schedule, cost, quality, compliance, and customer expectations. Develop and execute project plans, forecasts, risk mitigation strategies, and phase-gate deliverables from pre-construction through commissioning and closeout. Apply economic thinking to evaluate cost, risk, schedule, and value tradeoffs while making timely decisions that improve project outcomes. Build and develop high-performing teams by setting clear expectations, coaching for contribution, and aligning strengths to project and business needs. Coordinate customers, subcontractors, vendors, utilities, consultants, and internal partners to support transparent communication and disciplined execution. Strengthen customer and stakeholder relationships by resolving challenges, honoring commitments, and creating mutual long-term value. Who You Are (Basic Qualifications) Experience managing EPC, industrial, infrastructure, utility scale renewable energy, or large capital projects valued in the hundreds of millions of dollars Experience managing project scope, schedule, cost, forecasting, risk mitigation, contracts, or customer commitments. Experience leading project teams, subcontractors, vendors, or cross-functional stakeholders. Valid US driver's license. Legal authorization to work permanently in the United States for any employer without requiring a visa transfer or visa sponsorship now or in the future. What Will Put You Ahead EPC experience in Utility Solar, Wind, BESS, conventional power or industrial projects. Experience leading self-perform construction execution on large or complex projects. Bachelor's degree in Construction Management, Engineering, Business, or a related field. PMP, CCM, PE, or other relevant project management or construction industry certifications. Experience partnering with Business Development, Estimating, Operations, or customers to support project pursuits, repeat business, and executable project solutions. For this role, we anticipate paying $150K - $200K per year. This role is eligible for variable pay, issued as a monetary bonus or in another form. At Koch companies, we are entrepreneurs. This means we openly challenge the status quo, find new ways to create value and get rewarded for our individual contributions. Any compensation range provided for a role is an estimate determined by available market data. The actual amount may be higher or lower than the range provided considering each candidate's knowledge, skills, abilities, and geographic location. If you have questions, please speak to your recruiter about the flexibility and detail of our compensation philosophy. Hiring Philosophy All Koch companies value diversity of thought, perspectives, aptitudes, experiences, and backgrounds. We are Military Ready and Second Chance employers. Learn more about our hiring philosophy here . Who We Are As a Koch Engineered Solutions company, DEPCOM Power is a leading energy solutions partner for the utility solar and broader energy industries, providing project development support, engineering, procurement and construction, energy storage, repowering and operations and maintenance services. Our highly skilled team of conventional and renewable power industry experts work to deliver the lowest cost of energy and the highest rate of return. At Koch, employees are empowered to do what they do best to make life better. Learn how our business philosophy helps employees unleash their potential while creating value for themselves and the company. Our Benefits Our goal is for each employee, and their families, to live fulfilling and healthy lives. We provide essential resources and support to build and maintain physical, financial, and emotional strength - focusing on overall wellbeing so you can focus on what matters most. Our benefits plan includes - medical, dental, vision, flexible spending and health savings accounts, life insurance, ADD, disability, retirement, paid vacation/time off, educational assistance, and may also include infertility assistance, paid parental leave and adoption assistance. Specific eligibility criteria is set by the applicable Summary Plan Description, policy or guideline and benefits may vary by geographic region. If you have questions on what benefits apply to you, please speak to your recruiter. Additionally, everyone has individual work and personal needs. We seek to enable the best work environment that helps you and the business work together to produce superior results. Equal Opportunities Equal Opportunity Employer, including disability and protected veteran status. Except where prohibited by state law, some offers of employment are conditioned upon successfully passing a drug test. This employer uses E-Verify. Please click here for additional information.
